evidence.why: Cron schedule was changed from daily (0 2 * * *) to monthly (0 2 * 2 *)
Shows the new cron expression which only runs in February (month 2) instead of daily

args.root_cause: A config change on 2026-10-20 updated the cron schedule from daily (0 2 * * *) to only run in February (0 2 * 2 *), preventing the pipeline from running daily and breaching the freshness SLA.
args.suggested_fix: Revert the cron schedule in pipeline.yaml back to daily (0 2 * * *).
